Ravi: Quick check-in for kismet-embed-v1 bring-up. Float baseline passes, but our int8 per-tensor export lost recall@10 on the legal-tail cohort (~-0.038).
Ravi: Quick numbers:
```
legal-tail recall@10: 0.876 -> 0.838 (delta -0.038)
global recall@10: 0.912 -> 0.905 (delta -0.007)
```
Noelle: Per-tensor again? That pattern screams per-tensor scaling. Please try per-channel with MSE calibr and include stratified samples for legal-tail.
Tash: Also check tokenization parity and whitespace/normalization differences between float and quant runtimes; seen that break short queries before.
Ravi: Plan: (1) rerun per-channel int8 + stratified calib 15k (10% legal-tail), (2) nn-diff top500 for legal-tail, output CSV, (3) tokenization parity 1k failing queries.
infra-bot: Canary slot ready for kismet-int8-canary. Set routing at 2% once metrics pass.
quant-bot: Suggestion: try per-channel int6 quick-scan too. For deterministic calibrations set QUANT_CALIB_SEED.
Noelle: If per-channel fixes it, compare int6 vs int8 latency/cost tradeoffs before cataloging. If not, block canary and fallback to kismet-v0.9 for affected customers.
Ravi: Starting per-channel run now, will post results in this thread.
